title: Tamga Network Besu node declaration
description: An operator's declaration of one Besu node (ADR-0052 K2). Not written to the chain. A validator declaration enters the node allowlist only if the address derived from node_public_key is the ACTIVE validator address of `state` in Governance. No personal data: `contact` is the institution's role address, never a person's name.

state.description: Governance member code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case)

role.description: validator: QBFT validator (in every operator's allowlist); rpc: the operator's own RPC/full node (only in that operator's allowlist)

node_public_key.description: secp256k1 node public key (enode id): uncompressed, without the 04 prefix and without 0x — 128 lower-case hex characters

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 literal (Besu node allowlists do not accept DNS names by default)

contact.description: the institution's operations contact (role mailbox or https page) — no personal names
